scope: Installed distributions and declared dependency edges. Optional extras are not enabled by this lock.

build.name: build
requires: virtualenv >= 20.17 ; extra == "virtualenv" and ( python_version >= '3.10' and python_version < '3.14')

huggingface_hub.name: huggingface_hub
requires: hf-xet<2.0.0,>=1.6.0; platform_machine == "x86_64" or platform_machine == "amd64" or platform_machine == "AMD64" or platform_machine == "arm64" or platform_machine == "aarch64"

streamlit.name: streamlit
requires: uvloop>=0.15.2; (sys_platform != "win32" and sys_platform != "cygwin" and platform_python_implementation != "PyPy") and extra == "performance"

urllib3.name: urllib3
requires: brotlicffi>=0.8.0; ((os_name != "nt" or python_version >= "3") and platform_python_implementation != "CPython") and extra == "brotli"
brotli==1.0.9; (os_name != "nt" and python_version < "3" and platform_python_implementation == "CPython") and extra == "brotli"

uvicorn.name: uvicorn
requires: uvloop>=0.15.1; (sys_platform != 'win32' and (sys_platform != 'cygwin' and platform_python_implementation != 'PyPy')) and extra == 'standard'
